# Pocket Tasks

Tokage deterministic demo. No model calls.

Supports add, completion, filtering, remaining counts and persistence.
Run `npm test` for local verification. Demo-mode acceptance feedback is simulated.

en.request: Please improve Pocket Tasks with task completion, filtering, remaining-task counts, and persistence. Keep add-task behavior. Plan first, define contracts and write scopes, parallelize independent tasks, add regression tests and delivery notes, and wait for my approval.
en.intro: This is a prerecorded Fable 5.1 demo plan, supplied by Mock with zero model usage. After the data layer, operations, views and storage tests run in parallel, followed by integration, regression and delivery.

spec.raw:
## Goal
Add completion, filters, remaining counts and persistence to Pocket Tasks.
## Scope
- Task operations, persistence, views, integration, regression and delivery
## Decisions
- Mock supplies model output and acceptance feedback; files, Git and scheduling use real implementations.
spec.goal: Add completion, filters, remaining counts and persistence to Pocket Tasks.
inScope: Task operations, persistence, views, integration, regression and delivery
decisions: Mock supplies model output and acceptance feedback; files, Git and scheduling use real implementations.

contracts.title: Task data and storage
contracts.content: Task = { id: string, title: string, completed: boolean }; loadTasks(storage): Task[]; saveTasks(storage, tasks): void;

contracts.title: Operations and views
contracts.content: addTask(tasks, id, title); toggleTask(tasks, id); filterTasks(tasks, 'all' | 'active' | 'completed'); remainingCount(tasks); renderTasks(tasks, filter); createApp(storage);

tasks.goal: Store tasks and recover safely from malformed data.

criteria: Store tasks and recover safely from malformed data.

tasks.title: Task operations and filtering
tasks.goal: Add, toggle and filter tasks without mutating the source list.

criteria: Add, toggle and filter tasks without mutating the source list.

tasks.title: Task view and counters
tasks.goal: Render filters, completion state and remaining counts.

criteria: Render filters, completion state and remaining counts.

tasks.title: Persistence regression tests
tasks.goal: Verify round trips and malformed-data recovery.

criteria: Verify round trips and malformed-data recovery.

tasks.title: Application integration
tasks.goal: Connect task operations, rendering and persistence.

criteria: Connect task operations, rendering and persistence.

tasks.title: End-to-end regression tests
tasks.goal: Verify the complete add, toggle, filter and reload workflow.

criteria: Verify the complete add, toggle, filter and reload workflow.

tasks.title: Review and delivery documentation
tasks.goal: Document contracts, checks, limitations and usage.

en.working: Reading upstream contracts and artifacts before writing demo files.
en.completed: Produced the scripted implementation using real file and Git operations in the isolated demo repository.
en.downstream: Use the merged upstream artifacts and verify the contracts.
en.acceptance: Acceptance feedback is supplied by Mock; it does not mean a test command was executed.
en.failure: Demo: scripted execution failure; no real model was called.
en.gatePass: Demo: simulated acceptance passed; no command was executed.
en.gateFail: Demo: simulated acceptance failed. Remaining count must exclude completed tasks. Repair and retry.

zh.request: 请改进 Pocket Tasks，增加任务完成与取消完成、全部/未完成/已完成筛选、剩余任务计数，以及持久化。保留新增任务能力。请先规划，明确契约、依赖和写入范围，让独立任务并行，补充回归测试和交付说明，等待我审阅后再执行。
zh.intro: 这是 Fable 5.1 的预编演示规划，实际来源为 Mock，模型用量为零。数据层完成后，业务、视图和存储测试可以并行；随后集成、回归并交付。

## Scope
- 任务操作、持久化、视图、集成、回归和交付
## Decisions
- 模型输出和验收反馈由 Mock 提供；文件、Git 和调度使用实际实现。

zh.readme:
# Pocket Tasks

Tokage 隔离演示项目，零模型调用。

支持新增、完成切换、筛选、剩余数量和持久化。
可在本地运行 `npm test`；演示模式中的验收反馈是模拟结果。
